page.overview:
Who is Bradel?

Bradel was a Human male Commander who served the Galactic Republic during the Cold War and the Alderaan Civil War. In 3643 BBY, Bradel was in contact with Katei Elinari Panteer, who was one of the surviving Panteers.

Bradel is a character from the massively multi-player online role playing game Star Wars: The Old Republic released by BioWare in 2011.
